item.title: Lomani and Volavola's 50th Test ends in disappointment as Flying Fijians suffer 54-17 defeat to France
item.description: Frank Lomani and Ben Volavola's 50th Test did not go as they had hoped as the FIJI Water Flying Fijians suffered a 54-17 defeat to a fired-up France side in Lyon. Costly mistakes hurt the Flying Fijians, including dropped balls, free kicks conceded at scrum time for failing to hook the ball, and a yellow card to Mesake Vocevoce.
item.content:encoded:
Frank Lomani and Ben Volavola's 50th Test did not go as they had hoped as the FIJI Water Flying Fijians suffered a 54-17 defeat to a fired-up France side in Lyon.

Costly mistakes hurt the Flying Fijians, including dropped balls, free kicks conceded at scrum time for failing to hook the ball, and a yellow card to Mesake Vocevoce.

Vinaya Habosi and Selestino Ravutaumada scored Fiji's two tries, with Volavola converting both, while Simi Kuruvoli added a penalty.

France ran in eight tries but will be concerned about Romain Ntamack, who left the field with his arm in a sling following an apparent injury.

Isikeli Rabitu, who was initially named to start at fly-half, was withdrawn from the starting line-up and replaced by Vilimoni Botitu.

Among Fiji's standout performers were Kitione Salawa, who impressed in defence, and No. 8 Nathan Hughes, who carried strongly and broke seven tackles.

While some refereeing decisions appeared to go against Fiji, the Flying Fijians' costly errors and missed opportunities contributed significantly to the defeat.

The Flying Fijians will now look to regroup under coach Jake White as they prepare to face Ireland next Sunday at the Aviva Stadium.

item.title: Ra creates history after beating Inkk Farebrother Trophy holders Naitasiri 32-27
item.description: Ra has created history this afternoon after beating Inkk Farebrother Trophy holders Naitasiri 32-27. The scores were locked 20-20 at half time.
item.content:encoded:
Ra has created history this afternoon after beating Inkk Farebrother Trophy holders Naitasiri 32-27.

The scores were locked 20-20 at half time.

Ra quickly gained the upper hand in the second half by scoring a try but failed to convert the kick.

Naitasiri quickly replied with a converted try to regain the lead 27-25.

Ra scored after the fulltime hooter when a yellow card was shown to Naitasiri, and they capitalised on that penalty to score and win the game.

Nadroga will challenge for the Trophy next Saturday.

The holders will then take on Tailevu on 21st November before the scheduled challenge matches conclude against Nadi on 28th November.

item.title: Khelan and Kwong finish swimming events as Fiji futsal side loses 6-0 to Venezuela
item.description: Fiji swimmers Grace-Elizabeth Khelan and Thaddeus Kwong have completed their events at the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar, Senegal, while the women's futsal team has ended its Group A campaign following a 6-0 defeat to Venezuela. In the women's 50-metre backstroke heats, Khelan clocked 32.30 seconds to finish 29th out of 45 swimmers.
item.content:encoded:
Fiji swimmers Grace-Elizabeth Khelan and Thaddeus Kwong have completed their events at the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar, Senegal, while the women's futsal team has ended its Group A campaign following a 6-0 defeat to Venezuela.

In the women's 50-metre backstroke heats, Khelan clocked 32.30 seconds to finish 29th out of 45 swimmers.

Kwong recorded a time of 28.04 seconds in the men's 50-metre backstroke heats, placing 16th out of 33 competitors.

In triathlon, Fiji's representative Josiah Crocker was unable to finish the men's event after his bicycle was damaged during the race.
